supported_sources: Official LinkedIn OpenID Connect API (/v2/userinfo) via LINKEDIN_ACCESS_TOKEN secret
Official LinkedIn Data Export Archive CSVs (Profile.csv, Certifications.csv, Positions.csv)
limitations: LinkedIn's public Consumer API (/v2/userinfo) only exposes basic identity fields (name, email, picture) without Partner Program approval.
Full headline, positions, education, and certifications are not exposed via standard unprivileged LinkedIn REST APIs; scraping or cookie auth is prohibited.
All external career updates detected via OAuth or official LinkedIn Data Export CSVs are staged into pending_changes and require explicit approval before updating profile-data/*.json.
